name: crew-candy-shop
brief: Lincoln, Roosevelt and the pirate dance the candy-shop routine on the ninja's stage, about a minute, one take from the stage's cameras. All three ways of making motion are in it: they wait in the wings (our pose), walk on one after another (sentences, Kimodo), dance 47 seconds of the routine as the three in the clip did, Lincoln out front (read off the video by GEM-X, each his own dancer, the formation kept), bow to the house together (a sentence) and stand easy (our pose), with a MotionBricks join at every change. No sound: the song is not ours. Needs the clip's motion for all three: `just video candy-shop "" 1:2,1:3,2:2,2:3` after choosing person 1 on its page.

beats.action: each waits in the wings, walks on in turn (the one going furthest first) and takes his place
beats.driven_by: poses: stand. text: three walks, each held to the set's path

beats.action: the routine, seconds 5.4 to 53 of the clip, each role one of its three dancers, standing to each other as they did
beats.driven_by: video: candy-shop, persons 1 (front), 3 (left of the picture), 2 (right), one formation on the centre mark

beats.action: a bow to the house, together
beats.driven_by: text, each where the dance left him
